newsitem.title: USA: TMP Worldwide buys 4 ad agencies.
newsitem.headline: TMP Worldwide buys 4 ad agencies.

text.p: TMP Worldwide Inc said Wednesday it bought three European recruitment advertising agencies and a Canadian yellow page advertising agency.

TMP expects the acquisitions to add $5 million in annual commissions and fees. A spokesman declined to discuss the purchase price but said he expected the acquisitions "to be mildly accretive to us right out of the box."
The company bought privately-held Mandate Arbeidsmarktcommunicatie BV, Van Daalen en Partners BV in the Netherlands and Resource Recruitment of Antwerp, Belgium.
TMP also bought yellow-page advertising agency Dir-Ad of Canada. TMP added that its own yellow page business posted $434 million in gross billings and $94.5 million in commissions and fees in 1996.
TMP went public in December for $14 a share. Since then the stock has risen nearly 60 percent. Shares were off 1/8 to 22-3/8 in early Wednesday trading.
